01. About

Who Am I?

I'm Shubham Jaiswal, a Data Scientist & ML Engineer and B.Sc. graduate (Statistics & Computer Science, 2026) from Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith (MGKVP), Varanasi, with hands-on internship experience at Amdox Technologies, Cognifyz Technologies, and Soft Nexis Technology.

I build end-to-end ML systems — from data cleaning and feature engineering to model evaluation and deployment as live, working applications — across healthcare, finance, and retail, including medical diagnosis AI, fraud detection, and credit risk analytics.

I'm currently seeking a full-time role in Data Science, ML Engineering, or Analytics, and I enjoy learning through certifications, Kaggle, and self-directed projects.
